latest_release.name: v4.0.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Update CHANGELOG for version 4.0.0 release by @JonoB in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/228
* Return 404 rather than 500 for subscription links that no longer resolve by @emtiazzahid in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/225
* Avoid passing null to str_replace() when merging campaign content by @emtiazzahid in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/224
* Fix PostalAdapter by @L4ky in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/205
* Timezone for displayDate Helper defaults to config timezone by @neurotools in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/209
* Add IDs to campaign statuses in migration by @daniel-lucio in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/217
* Update HandleSesWebhook.php by @recoverjp in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/193
* Ignore spaces when merging subscriber's tag to a message by @bfabio in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/161
* Revert #161: merge tags {{email}}, {{first_name}}, {{last_name}} no longer replaced by @JonoB in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/229
* Fix SMTP sends being reported as successful when they fail by @emtiazzahid in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/223
* Fix: slow campaign query by @tapsu01 in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/204
* Run CI on pull requests from forks by @JonoB in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/230
* Normalize header case for message ID extraction by @Jamesking56 in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/213
* Add "SubscriptionChange" Webhook from Postmark  by @ruvus11 in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/191

## New Contributors
* @emtiazzahid made their first contribution in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/225
* @L4ky made their first contribution in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/205
* @neurotools made their first contribution in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/209
* @daniel-lucio made their first contribution in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/217
* @recoverjp made their first contribution in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/193
* @bfabio made their first contribution in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/161
* @tapsu01 made their first contribution in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/204
* @Jamesking56 made their first contribution in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/213
* @ruvus11 made their first contribution in https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/pull/191

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/compare/V4.0.0...v4.0.1

detail.readme: Modern open-source self-hosted email marketing. - [Website](https://sendportal.io) - [Documentation (V4)](https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-docs/tree/fb25c19f5b7ee1d03de27d149589e430cc526707/v4) ## Introduction The core functionality of SendPortal is contained within the [SendPortal Core](https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core) package. If you would like to add SendPortal to an existing application, you only require this package. ## Features SendPortal includes subscriber and list management, email campaigns, message tracking, reports and multiple workspaces/domains in a modern, flexible and scalable application. SendPortal integrates with [Amazon SES](https://aws.amazon.com/ses), [Postmark](https://postmarkapp.com), [Sendgrid](https://sendgrid.com), [Mailgun](https://www.mailgun.com/) and [Mailjet](https://www.mailjet.com). The [SendPortal](https://github.com/mettle/sendportal) application acts as a wrapper around SendPortal Core. This will allow you to run your own copy of SendPortal as a stand-alone application, including user authentication and multiple workspaces. ## Installation SendPortal can be installed as a stand-alone application (i.e. including everything you need to run SendPortal), or as a package inside an existing Laravel application. The V4 guides below are hosted in the documentation repository while sendportal.io is being updated. If you would like to install SendPortal as a stand-alone application, please follow the [installation guide](https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-docs/blob/fb25c19f5b7ee1d03de27d149589e430cc526707/v4/installation.md). If you would like to add SendPortal to an existing application, please follow the [package installation guide](https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-docs/blob/fb25c19f5b7ee1d03de27d149589e430cc526707/v4/package-installation.md). If you are upgrading from SendPortal V3, please follow the [upgrade guide](https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-docs/blob/fb25c19f5b7ee1d03de27d149589e430cc526707/v4/upgrade-guide.md). ## Requirements SendPortal V4 requires: - PHP 8.3+ - Laravel 12+ - MySQL (≥ 5.7) or PostgreSQL (≥ 10) If you are on PHP 8.2 or Laravel 10/11, please use [SendPortal V3](https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/releases/tag/v3.0.0) If you are on an earlier version of PHP (7.3+) or Laravel (8+), please use [SendPortal V2](https://github.com/mettle/sendportal-core/releases/tag/v2.0.5)
